# Hermetic regression metadata

`expected-audit.json` contains only hashes, counts, paths, engine identity, and
other noncopyrighted metadata for the external `xml-schemas.zip` acceptance
artifact. The archive and its source text are not committed.

`synthetic-project/` is original CC0-1.0 test content. It exercises a common
ZIP root, nested safe-parent references, shared dependencies, annotations,
valid-but-unsupported visualization components, and deterministic package
assembly without reproducing Hermetic Foundry schema text.
